## When ARGUS suggests it

The Amsler grid shows new marked cells compared with your previous map, or your near acuity is at Watch or higher.

## Steps

1. Repeat the test with each eye. [SRC_VISION_ISS]
2. Use your anticipation glasses if they were issued. [demo wording]
3. Schedule an imaging exam. [SRC_VISION_ISS]
4. Send a report to the flight surgeon. [demo wording]
